title: How I Learned to Fly
content: I was obsessed with flying machines in my younger years.Before I graduated high school I had built and flown: radio-controlled gliders, hot air balloons, a variety of paper gliders, rubber-band powered balsa models, a welded steel glider that “flew” underwater, model rockets, hot air ballooons, rising parachutes, and various kites and kite-string-climbers.--More at mySubstack post.
